proposals.rationale: Hypothesis: operating without the specified argon context could expose the air-sensitive catalytic system, base, or boron reagent to oxygen or moisture.
Hypothesis: loss of the reactor-to-heater connection could prevent the intended 80 °C reaction temperature from being achieved or maintained.
Hypothesis: an absent heater binding could leave the HeatChill operation without an assigned heating apparatus.
Hypothesis: charging the ligand in place of the iridium precatalyst would remove the intended metal-catalyst source.
Hypothesis: charging the iridium precatalyst in place of the specified ligand would disrupt the intended catalyst-to-ligand formulation.
Hypothesis: charging KOtBu in place of B2pin2 would remove the intended boryl-source reagent while increasing base charge.
Hypothesis: charging B2pin2 at the substrate-addition step instead of N,N-dibutylbenzamide would omit the intended substrate from the heated reaction mixture.
